formatted_references.text: Annie Joseph. Description of the Tribal dialects of Devikolam. PhD thesis, Department of Linguistics, University of Kerala, 1980. Unpublished Ph.D. thesis reported by Nair 2013, p. 49. Original thesis not independently collated; no thesis page references supplied in Nair.

Ravi Sankar S. Nair. Tribal Languages of Kerala. Language in India, 13(7):45–49, July 2013. Nair describes Mannan speech as closely related to Malayalam and a possible dialect, while documenting distinctive features. The chapter lists four taluks in Idukki but no exact elicitation site or speaker. A tentative relationship between plural kaaṭ-u and a generic Dravidian plural suffix is preserved as an attributed source claim without an ancestry edge. Traditional personal names and the community name remain documentary evidence. URL: https://languageinindia.com/july2013/ravisankarkeralatriballanguages.html.
